sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def heights(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    hs={}
    for name,(c0,c1) in {'C1':(0,11),'C2':(15,26),'C3':(30,41),'C4':(45,53),'C5':(57,63)}.items():
        col=(c0+c1)//2
        top=None
        for r in range(64):
            if a[r][col]=='W': top=r; break
        hs[name]=64-top if top is not None else 0
    return hs
def tops(fr):
    return {k:64-v if v else None for k,v in heights(fr).items()}
h=heights(current_frame); print("start",h, "tops", tops(current_frame))
# move C5->C4 (3x), then C4->C3 (5x) to get C3=24 (top r40, inside T2 band r34-45)
for i in range(3):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':61,'col':52}])
    h=heights(current_frame)
    if h.get('C4',0)==0 and i<2: pass
print("after C5->C4", h)
for i in range(5):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':61,'col':40}])
    h=heights(current_frame)
print("after C4->C3", h, "tops", tops(current_frame))
print("C3 top row:", tops(current_frame)['C3'], "in band r34-45?", 34<=tops(current_frame)['C3']<=45)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def heights(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    hs={}
    for name,(c0,c1) in {'C1':(0,11),'C2':(15,26),'C3':(30,41),'C4':(45,53),'C5':(57,63)}.items():
        col=(c0+c1)//2
        top=None
        for r in range(64):
            if a[r][col]=='W': top=r; break
        hs[name]=64-top if top is not None else 0
    return hs
def tops(fr):
    return {k:64-v if v else None for k,v in heights(fr).items()}
h=heights(current_frame); print("start",h, "tops", tops(current_frame))

    h=heights(current_frame)
    if h.get('C4',0)==0 and i<2: pass
print("after C5->C4", h)
